El Bambu Eco Residencias is located in the Punta Leona Resort in Costa Rica. Situated on the entrance road towards Punta Leona Resort is this residential community with an ecological concept. The master plan of this development consists of 230 lots for homes and condominiums on a 16 hectares area. The lots that are for sale at El Bambu are the size of 300m2 to 400m2. El Bambu residents have a Punta Leona membership and have access to all the amenities of the resort. There is a supermarket, restaurants, three swimming pools, tennis courts and miniature golf. The homes at El Bambu would make for a comfortable permanent residence or perfect vacation home that can also serve as a rental when not in Costa Rica with all of Punta Leona resort amenities within your reach. Imagine waking up to the soothing sound of waves and the vibrant energy of downtown steps away. This lot offers an incomparable lifestyle, where you can enjoy the tranquility of the palm trees rustling in the breeze and simultaneously have the opportunity to conduct business and pleasure.



The versatility of this lot is unmatched as it has water and electricity infrastructure, providing a solid foundation for a perfect development according to your vision. Whether you envision a dynamic commercial space, a charming residential retreat, or a harmonious combination of both, the possibilities are endless.



This lot presents an extraordinary opportunity for entrepreneurs to establish a thriving business at the intersection of commerce and leisure. The bustling streets of central Jacó offer a vibrant market, ready to be explored for boutiques, cozy cafes, and many restaurants.



On the other hand, for those seeking a tranquil residential retreat, this lot offers the perfect canvas to create your dream home in paradise. With the beach just a leisurely walk away, you can enjoy daily adventures and relax amidst the Pacific Ocean's sun-kissed shores and crystal-clear waters.



This lot represents the best of both worlds: a harmonious combination of urban convenience and coastal tranquility. Whether you're drawn to the city center's dynamic energy or the beach's quiet serenity, this prime location in Jacó, Costa Rica, offers a truly unparalleled lifestyle. Take advantage of the opportunity to leave your mark on this vibrant community and create memories that will last a lifetime.

¡Bienvenido al pináculo de la vida costera y la comodidad urbana en Jaco, Costa Rica! Ubicado en el corazón de esta vibrante ciudad costera, encontrará un lote privilegiado que combina funcionalidad y serenidad de una manera verdaderamente única. Esta excepcional propiedad está ubicada a solo unos pasos del centro de Jacó y de la pintoresca playa, lo que la convierte en el lugar perfecto para un desarrollo de uso mixto.



Imagínese despertarse con el relajante sonido de las olas y la vibrante energía del centro de la ciudad a solo unos pasos de distancia. Este lote ofrece un estilo de vida incomparable, donde podrá disfrutar de la tranquilidad de las palmeras susurrando con la brisa y al mismo tiempo tener la oportunidad de realizar negocios y placer.



La versatilidad de este lote es inigualable ya que cuenta con infraestructura de agua y electricidad, brindando una base sólida para un desarrollo perfecto según su visión. Ya sea que imagine un espacio comercial dinámico, un retiro residencial encantador o una combinación armoniosa de ambos, las posibilidades son infinitas.
